sources.locator: Title search: 推测执行侧信道

statement.zh: **攻击**：推测执行侧信道（Speculative Execution Side-Channel）。Meltdown 论文摘要给出的机制是：「Meltdown exploits side effects of out-of-order execution on modern processors to read arbitrary kernel-memory locations including personal data and passwords」，并说明「Out-of-order execution is an indispensable performance feature and present in a wide range of modern processors」——性能特性本身的副作用被用作观察通道。
statement.en: **Attack**: Speculative Execution Side-Channel (推测执行侧信道).The Meltdown abstract gives the mechanism: "Meltdown exploits side effects of out-of-order execution on modern processors to read arbitrary kernel-memory locations including personal data and passwords", and notes that "Out-of-order execution is an indispensable performance feature and present in a wide range of modern processors" — the side effects of a performance feature become the observation channel.

statement.zh: 摘要把根因定位在硬件而非软件：「The root cause of Meltdown is the hardware.The attack is independent of the operating system, and it does not rely on any software vulnerabilities.」，因此隔离失效不是某个程序的缺陷；摘要还说明在受影响系统上「Meltdown enables an adversary to read memory of other processes or virtual machines in the cloud without any permissions or privileges」。
statement.en: The abstract places the root cause in hardware rather than software: "The root cause of Meltdown is the hardware.The attack is independent of the operating system, and it does not rely on any software vulnerabilities." The isolation failure is therefore not a bug in one program, and on affected systems "Meltdown enables an adversary to read memory of other processes or virtual machines in the cloud without any permissions or privileges".

statement.zh: 该论文同时给出部署结论：「We show that the KAISER defense mechanism for KASLR has the important (but inadvertent) side effect of impeding Meltdown.We stress that KAISER must be deployed immediately…」——即文中所称针对 KASLR 的 KAISER 防御机制顺带阻碍了该攻击，论文的部署结论是 KAISER 必须立即部署。
statement.en: The paper also delivers a deployment conclusion: "We show that the KAISER defense mechanism for KASLR has the important (but inadvertent) side effect of impeding Meltdown.We stress that KAISER must be deployed immediately…" — what the abstract calls the KAISER defense mechanism for KASLR incidentally impedes the attack, and the paper’s deployment conclusion is that KAISER must be deployed immediately.

statement.zh: 摘要对影响面只作有限声明：「The attack works on different Intel microarchitectures since at least 2010 and potentially other processors are affected」——文中点名的是 Intel 微架构，其他厂商只是`可能被影响`的表述；该条目目据此不使用超出摘要范围的厂商结论。攻击的成立也依赖可被推测执行的乱序机制，因此无法通过软件漏洞修补，只能靠部署隔离与硬件修正。
statement.en: The abstract makes only a bounded claim about scope: "The attack works on different Intel microarchitectures since at least 2010 and potentially other processors are affected" — Intel microarchitectures are named, other vendors appear only as potentially affected, and this entry draws no conclusion beyond that.Success also depends on out-of-order execution itself, so it is not a software bug that can be patched away; the abstract puts the root cause in the hardware.

statement.zh:
arXiv 记录 1801.01207《Meltdown》由 Moritz Lipp、Michael Schwarz、Daniel Gruss、Thomas Prescher、Werner Haas、Stefan Mangard、Paul Kocher、Daniel Genkin、Yuval Yarom 与 Mike Hamburg 撰写，提交于 2018 年 1 月 3 日（星期三），学科标注为 cs.CR；摘要本身即说明这是 2018 年初披露的一类推测执行读取攻击的原始文献记录。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{attack}}_A(\lambda)=\Pr[\mathrm{Game}_A(\lambda)=1]-\frac12\)。输入：输入：推测执行侧信道的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：λ 安全参数；Game 把攻击目标写成挑战-响应游戏。
statement.en: The arXiv record 1801.01207, "Meltdown", is authored by Moritz Lipp, Michael Schwarz, Daniel Gruss, Thomas Prescher, Werner Haas, Stefan Mangard, Paul Kocher, Daniel Genkin, Yuval Yarom and Mike Hamburg, submitted on Wednesday 3 January 2018 under cs.CR; the abstract itself is the primary record of this class of speculative-read attacks disclosed in early 2018.
